content.short: Hyper Ninja is a P2E action RPG on Injective where players manage warriors and dojos for on-chain rewards and growth.
content.description: Hyper Ninja is a ninja-themed play-to-earn action RPG built natively on the Injective blockchain. The game blends resource gathering, crystal refining, and clan-building mechanics, allowing players to recruit warriors and manage spirit energy to grow their personal dojos. By engaging in competitive combat and strategic management, users can earn on-chain rewards within a transparent and decentralized ecosystem. Designed for Injective's high-speed infrastructure, Hyper Ninja provides a seamless experience with digital ownership of assets, bridging traditional and Web3 gaming.
